title: Headlines
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose how much of a statement receives emphasis. A word highlight directs the eye more selectively than a box enclosing every line.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can vary emphasis while keeping a consistent headline voice, even across campaigns with very different messages.
demonstration: The same multiline headline appears in regular, highlighted and boxed treatments. Enlarged construction diagrams define clearance as one third of the letter height.
practical_value: Choose a regular headline for direct use, highlight a word for selective emphasis or box the whole headline when the complete message needs prominence.

content_islands.name: Margin construction
content_islands.spec: Place enlarged pale letters and pink guides above the examples. Show X as one third of the letter height.

content_islands.name: Three headline treatments
content_islands.spec: Align the same phrase in three columns, first in plain black, then with a word highlighted, then as colored type in a black box.
